themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents capable of independent research, analysis, and task execution, often involving autonomous workflows and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including code generation and review.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is changing jobs, skills requirements, and the overall employment landscape, including fears of job displacement and new opportunities.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Details on platforms and systems built to support AI development, research, and deployment, often with specialized features for data management and model training.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the use of AI chatbots for research purposes, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact on users, particularly in areas like mental health and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's application in the design process, from concept generation and prototyping to user interface design and iterating on product features.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or data to simulate user behavior for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, articles, or customer feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's ability to analyze text data, like reviews or social media posts, to understand and quantify user sentiment and opinions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
